caption:
Indeed I am near. I respond to the invocation of the supplicant when he calls upon Me.

Surah Al-Baqarah (2:186). Swipe through for the Arabic, then English, Mandarin, Korean, Japanese, Malay, Thai and Spanish.

Sources on the final slide.

#Quran #AlBaqarah #Dua #IslamicReminder #Deen
